review: Independent narrow B02 G3 contract v4 delta review
scope: Reviewed only the exact v4 delta against reviewed v3 contract, approved B02 plan, v3 review and pinned Authlib APIs. No product, test, service or database execution occurred.

delta_review.assessment: The v4 delta resolves G3-CONTRACT-TOKEN-ERROR-1. Only invalid_grant from HTTP 400/401 maps to user authentication failure. invalid_request and other OAuth provider errors map to a dependency failure; an OAuth error payload on HTTP 200 and invalid_grant on HTTP 500 also map to dependency failure. This separates a rejected/expired authorization code from malformed server-generated token requests and upstream protocol/configuration failures, without exposing provider descriptions. The cases are concrete independent test oracles.

The v4 diff leaves the reviewed v3 retention, admission, scheduler, lock, narrow DELETE privilege and migration test requirements unchanged. No new state-lifecycle or authority-boundary issue was introduced by the error-mapping delta.

The approved B02 parent plan SHA remains unchanged. G3 still does not claim real corporate SSO, AT-21, G4 or G6 completion; the revised error mapping does not narrow the original API, DB, workspace or follow-on scope.

limitations: This approves contract sufficiency only. Product implementation, TC coverage, migrations, scheduler lifecycle and runtime behavior remain unreviewed and unaccepted.
The contract delta was confirmed by structural JSON comparison: only `/oidc/network` error mapping and the `supersedes` record changed from v3.
